scientific_integrity: Complete algebraic proof and ordinary finite diagnostic program included. Numerical experiments do not prove all-size statements; external independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite homogeneous fixed–free chain, strictly positive viscous coefficients; statements concern undamped frequencies and asymptotic retained energy, not transient rates, other boundaries or nonlinear damping. Earlier literature covers the single-site frequency-locking phenomenon. Historical priority for combined damping and exact kick retention remains provisional.
title: Arithmetic duality of ground and bond damping in a fixed–free harmonic chain
